column26: Notes

Quick reload is 0.80s long. It triggers when you have emptied a magazine, and when you have a "quick magazine" available (indicated by the bars near your ammo count). Otherwise, a normal reload will occur.
Deals 75 damage without backstab.  Cannot hit multiple targets in one stab.  Backstab angle is 150 degrees.  Has an 800ms wind-up time.
Takes ~160ms to fire the 1st shot. Various methods of optimizing TTK: https://i.imgur.com/DLfa7hv.jpeg (qm = quick melee). TTK does not account for projectile travel time.

Takes ~640ms to charge a shot. Various methods of optimizing TTK: https://i.imgur.com/DLfa7hv.jpeg (qm = quick melee). TTK does not account for projectile travel time.  Damage increases from 60 to 124 (continuously) based on how long this weapon was charged.
Bullets are hitscan up until 40m, and then converted into projectiles afterwards.
TTK does not account for projectile travel time, or the initial delay when throwing the knives.  It represents more of a "time-to-death" calculation, if anything.
TTK does not account for projectile travel time, or the initial delay when throwing the knives.  It represents more of a "time-to-death" calculation, if anything.
Firing the weapon will cancel the reload animation.

Deals 99 damage on hit (9 x 11 pellets), and then an extra ~31 damage from the fire DoT that last for ~2 seconds.  DoT does not stack, and it resets on every hit.  With the DoT, it takes 2 hits to kill a Light (or 1 hit + quick-melee), 3 hits to kill a Medium, and 4 hits to kill a Heavy.
Inner blast radius for maximum damage is 0.6m.

LMB combo = 2x50 damage, then 2x60 damage, then 65 damage.  Can swap-cancel the combo when started.  Swap-cancel will not optimize TTK, but quick melee will. Deflecting bullets deals 100% damage to the enemy, and 10% to you (30% if glancing).  Blocking melee hits will reduce their damage to 25%.

15 bullets deal 345 damage to the body, so a Heavy player may be killable within 5 bursts upon taking chip damage.  In that scenario, its TTK vs. Heavy @ Body = 1.64s, and its TTK vs. Heavy @ Head = 1.14s (with 10 headshots).
Firing the weapon will cancel the reload animation.
Excellent hipfire accuracy.
(need information about whether or not the fire DoT sticks to the player while dealing damage with Flamethrower ammo)
Shots are hitscan within 25m, and then they become projectiles afterwards (with a projectile velocity of 280 m/s).  Firing the weapon will cancel the reload animation.

TTK assumes a full ramp-up to maximum fire rate.  Major levels of spread make it 100% accurate only at extreme close range (within ~5m).  Spin-up time until minimum fire rate (500 RPM) is 0.90s.  Spin-up time until maximum fire rate is 1.60s.
Rounds detonate on impact after the 1st bounce. Maximum fuse time = 2.5s. Explosion inner radius = 1.5m.

Quick reload is 0.80s long. It triggers when you have emptied a magazine, and when you have a "quick magazine" available (indicated by the bars near your ammo count). Otherwise, a normal reload will occur.
Shoots 2 bullets per round, spread out horizontally, each dealing 15 damage.
Cannot hit multiple targets in one swing.
LMB combo = 65 damage, then 80 damage, then 90 damage.  Has a 3-4m range.
Damage is per hit in a 3-hit combo.  Has a 3m radius.
